usage: Each check is independently assertable against a running build. severity 'block' must pass before ship. 'probe' is a hint, not a required implementation.

checks.assert: No monospace font on any player name, prose paragraph, nav item, button label, or position/team code
checks.probe: for each candidate node, getComputedStyle(n).fontFamily must not match /mono/i

checks.assert: tabular-nums present on numeric cells and absent from prose
checks.probe: getComputedStyle(cell).fontVariantNumeric includes 'tabular-nums'
checks.expect: true for numeric cells, false for prose

checks.assert: Zero border-radius on data cells and table rows
checks.probe: getComputedStyle(row).borderRadius

checks.assert: 6px radius on cards, buttons, chips; 12px on overlays
checks.probe: getComputedStyle(el).borderRadius

checks.assert: Light mode is not an inversion: canvas off-white, surfaces white, accents higher chroma
checks.probe: documentElement[data-theme=light] then read --bg,--panel,--acc

checks.assert: Saturated amber (--down) appears only on attention/scarcity/stale states
checks.probe: enumerate elements whose colour resolves to --down and classify

checks.assert: Every colour-carried meaning has a non-colour cue
checks.probe: for each colour-coded cell, assert a sibling glyph, weight change, rule, or the number itself

checks.assert: Baseline and live are both visible on the board row, in the queue, and in the player panel
checks.probe: count nodes rendering baseline and live per surface
checks.expect: both present on all three surfaces

checks.assert: adjustment.need and adjustment.run are shown separately, never pre-combined
checks.probe: player panel availability block text

checks.assert: With fewer than max(4, teams/2) picks logged, live reads 'not yet' and never the baseline
checks.probe: seed picks below threshold, read the live cell

checks.assert: Between half a round and a full round, rows are marked thin and the band is 1.6x wider
checks.probe: seed picks in that window, read the thin marker and band width

checks.assert: No availability figure appears without its 10-dot array
checks.probe: for each availability percentage node, find a sibling dot group of length 10

checks.assert: Changing a roster slot updates instantly with no job
checks.probe: change flex count, observe board without awaiting a job

checks.assert: Changing a scoring value changes NOTHING on screen until Recalculate completes
checks.probe: snapshot all numbers, edit ppr, re-snapshot

checks.assert: A pending scoring change shows the app-wide banner and a per-field old → new diff
checks.probe: edit ppr, assert banner node and diff rows

checks.assert: Editing settings marks availability STALE app-wide and the assistant refuses to quote it
checks.probe: edit teams, read availability cells and ask the assistant

checks.assert: A league that has never been simulated shows explicit nulls, not zeros
checks.probe: select the never-generated league, read availability

checks.assert: Player detail is a right side sheet at 440px with no dark scrim; board and clock stay visible
checks.probe: open detail; measure sheet width and scrim background

checks.assert: Panel order is identity → verdict → numbers → availability → derivation
checks.probe: read section order in the sheet

checks.assert: The action bar is sticky at the bottom of the sheet with an accent-filled primary
checks.probe: getComputedStyle(bar).position and primary button background

checks.assert: Rank derivation expands inline on the board row, not only in the panel
checks.probe: click the 'why' toggle on a row
checks.expect: derivation panel appears within the row's container

checks.assert: Mock grid and opponent cards render `teams` columns for any team count
checks.probe: set teams=12, count columns

checks.assert: Switching leagues preserves each league's own draft state
checks.probe: log picks in A, switch to B, switch back

checks.assert: No value on screen lacks a named backend field
checks.probe: every numeric cell has a trace affordance or a provenance line in scope

checks.assert: 0% never appears where the claim is 'not computed'
checks.probe: grep rendered text for '0%' and classify each

checks.assert: Consecutive empty sections collapse to one line
checks.probe: open a sparse player
checks.expect: one collapsed line, not stacked empty headers

checks.assert: Sample or generated data is labelled as such on screen
checks.probe: screens using sample data carry the label

checks.assert: Availability below 0.5% renders '<1%', not '0%'
checks.probe: read the smallest availability cell

checks.assert: Aggregates over incomplete sets carry a coverage disclosure
checks.probe: weekly total with missing projections
checks.expect: sentence naming what the total covers

nullStates.render: old numbers, greyed, labelled with generation timestamp

nullStates.situation: Multiple empty sections on one player
nullStates.render: one collapsed line naming everything missing

principles.rule: Every number on screen traces to a named backend field
principles.consequence: renaming a field is a product change, not a refactor

principles.rule: An explicit null is a real state; 0%, 0, — and 'not computed' are four different claims
principles.consequence: null states are first-class design, not error cases
a half-updated board is worse than an old one
premium means better organised, not roomier
